$comment: Jetcaster (mobile) sticker sheet. Jetcaster is the multi-form-factor sample — phone, Wear, TV and a Glance widget share one core. This catalog covers the phone tier; the Wear tier has its own sheet in catalog.wear.spec.json so the two can be compared side by side. Two things are worth knowing when reading this sheet. First, every entry here is dark: JetcasterTheme resolves darkScheme unconditionally and exposes no light path, so a 'light mode' preview would be fiction — the five other schemes the design system ships are surfaced as @ThemeCatalogs instead, which is the only place they are visible at all. Second, this module ships no app tour: Jetcaster's home is driven by Room plus live RSS fetches and the renderer has no network, so the app cold-starts with an empty database and no stable click targets, and the synthetic activity__MainActivity render is a near-empty frame for the same reason. The states below are therefore driven directly from the :core:domain-testing fixtures rather than through the running app.
